title: Page 5
content_zh:
童老夫人难得笑了起来，伸手替孙女把鬓角的碎发拢好，嗔怪道：“你呀，就知道玩，这么多年，祖母把你严严实实地看管在身边，你一定闷坏了吧？”
“不，我知道祖母都是为了我好，我也喜欢在祖母身边。”童悠悠鼻子犯酸，忍不住又要掉泪，赶紧依靠在祖母的肩头。
童老夫人叹口气，轻轻拍了拍孙女的肩膀，“不要怪祖母这么多年对你严厉，你父亲是个薄情又自私的人，京都府里的那位继室夫人更是面甜心苦，视你为眼中钉、肉中刺。幸好当年把你从京都带了回来，否则如今你怕是日子不好过。我总想着让你多学一些东西，有本事傍身，以后立足活命总能更容易一些，倒是让你辛苦了。”
童悠悠悄悄抹去眼泪，抱着祖母的胳膊撒娇，“祖母您说这些做什么？天下没有谁比祖母对我更好了，我怎么会不知道祖母的用心良苦。”
童老夫人欣慰的笑了，“你知道就好，祖母啊，怕是不能再陪你走下去了，本来还想着看你出嫁，可惜身体不争气啊。”
“祖母，您一定会长命百岁！”童悠悠哽咽，不想祖母再说下去。
童老夫人却是摇头，扶着孙女面对她，郑重说道：“悠悠，人有生老病死，谁也拦不住，你仔细听好了，祖母有几句话要嘱咐你。”
童悠悠还想说话，童老夫人却是推了她一把，吩咐道：“去把我的妆盒拿过来。”
她赶紧抹了泪水，走去梳妆台前，抱了那个三层的黑漆雕花妆盒。
童老夫人坐了起来，亲手
“我死后，以你父亲的心性，怕是不会守孝在家，必然要找门路，继续做官，但你一定会守。这样也好，回去京都守孝一年后，你在京都也住得熟悉了。
“我已经拜托过族长，那时候他会带几个族人去京都为你做主，操持你的婚事。你的婚事是当年你祖父定下来的，那户人家门第显赫，想必教出的子孙也会不错，即便有些差池，以你这些年学到的本事，也不会让日子过得太差。退一万步，就是再差也比在继母手下讨生活要好。
“另外，你记好了，回去京都后，京都城东有条青石巷子，青石巷子尽头有家杂货铺，叫胡氏杂货铺。那铺子的掌柜夫妻是我当年的陪嫁仆役，夫妻两个没有子女，很是忠心。这么多年一直待在京都，有几分人脉和本事，你在京都若是遇到困难，可以去找他们帮忙。你的嫁妆我也早早送去，让他们保管，嫁妆单子在这里，你拿着，以后有个参照。”
童老夫人说着把妆盒里的一本小册子拿了出来递给孙女，不等孙女说话，又拿出一迭厚厚的银票，每张银票都是二十两或五十两的小面额。
“这些银票是留给你的，以备万一使用。银票面额小，方便你去兑换，哪怕到了京都，手头也要有些银子打赏下人，这样日子才能过得松快一些。”
童悠悠捏着嫁妆单子和银票，再也忍不住眼泪，扑到祖母怀里，哽咽道：“祖母，求您不要离开，我舍不得祖母。”
童老夫人也不禁掉下泪水，抱着孙女不舍至极，但她还是硬着心肠把孙女推开。
“悠悠，你听我说，祖母知道你是个孝顺的孩子，但是回到京都之后，你一定要狠下心好好保护自己，祖母不能再护着你了，你只能靠自己。
“还有，咱们府里账面上还有三千两银子，想必够我的后事花费，茉莉几个丫鬟跟在我身边几年，很是尽心尽力，你若是不能带着她们回京都，就放她们自由吧，她们的家人还都不错，不会让她们后半辈子没有着落。至于你身边的丫鬟，你自己决定就好，带几个得力的回京都，有事时也才有人为你出力。
“家里的田地，城外那两百亩水田，我已经许给族里了，你不用惦记，京都来人或者你父亲回来，谁也不敢说一个不字。”

听到这里童悠悠才知道，祖母为何笃定孝期满后，族人会去替她撑腰，原来祖母交出了城外的良田当做交换条件。
童老夫人一口气说了这么多话，有些疲惫，把妆盒推到孙女手边，笑道：“这些东西，你若是不嫌弃样子老，就留下做个念想。库房里的东西则留给京都来人收拾，不留下一些，你那个继母怕是更要为难你了。”
童悠悠伤心难过至极，祖母自知时日无多之际尚且不忘为她做如此安排。“祖母，您放心，您的孙女不是好欺负的，一定会活得好好的。”
“祖母信你。”童老夫人笑得慈祥，抬手指了指桌上的茶杯。
童悠悠赶紧过去换了一杯温茶，可惜端到床边的时候，却见祖母已经闭上眼睛。
“啪！”茶杯落在地上摔得粉碎。
“祖母，呜呜呜……祖母！您快醒醒，祖母，您不要抛下我啊！”童悠悠跪在床边，哭得几乎要昏死。
屋外的丫鬟们听到声音全冲了进来，见状也都哭了起来，“老夫人，呜呜呜……老夫人！”
陈管家和仆役们不好进屋，只能跪在院子里，也哭得厉害。
都说一朝天子一朝臣，在童家大院也是如此，童老夫人过世了，以后必是京都来人接手大院。到时候，他们的去留都是问题，人人皆悲伤主子的过世，也在担心自己的未来。
第三章 不见儿子来(1)
童悠悠这几年一直在帮助童老夫人处置家事，虽然悲伤不舍，到底不能耽误祖母的后事。
她极力忍住悲痛，抹干泪水，开始吩咐众人忙碌起来。老夫人的寿衣和寿材早有准备，这会儿只要伺候老夫人擦洗干净，换上寿衣，装裹进寿材就可以了。
但还要搭置灵棚，给族人亲朋报丧，琐碎杂事很多。
这么忙碌着，天色慢慢就亮了。
童家大院正门大开，门旁竖起了高高的灵幡。童氏一族的族长，带了十几个族人，急匆匆赶了过来，皆面色悲伤。
童家原本只是一个普通的农门小户，当年童老太爷娶了童老夫人，进门带了大笔的嫁妆。童老夫人扶持族里的孩子们读书，没少花费钱财，可惜童氏一族灵气有限，居然只有童悠悠的爹算是出人头地，考上进士，进京做了个小官。
其余同辈的兄弟们到底读了几年书，能写会算，比起普通人家的孩子要更容易谋得生计，这些年，有的族人在城里做了账房先生，有的开了买卖铺子，有的在衙门做捕快小吏，加在一处倒也算人多势众。以至于童氏一族在台州勉强上得了台面，日子自然也都过得不错。族人还算感恩，听得童老太太过世就都赶了过来。
族长今年已经六十岁了，头发胡子花白，家里四个儿子正是壮年，所以在族里很有威信，为人虽然有些贪，但还算公正。
更何况，童老夫人之前送去了两百亩水田的地契，以后田里出产，足够族里的孩子们继续读书科考，甚至年年祭祖的花费，族里有什么困难也足够应付。

于情于理，族里对童老夫人的丧事都要重视。
陈管家带了仆役们在院子里搭设灵棚，童悠悠请了族长和族人们到堂屋坐下喝茶，商议如何发丧。
童悠悠一个女孩子不好出面张罗这些事，索性把账房里的银钱拿出两千两，一并交给族长。
content_en:
Mrs. Tong rarely laughed, stretched out her hand to tuck her granddaughter's hair away from her temples, and said angrily: "You, you just know how to play. For so many years, your grandmother has kept you under strict supervision. You must be bored, right?"
"No, I know grandma is doing it for my own good, and I also like to be by grandma's side." Tong Youyou's nose felt sore, she couldn't help but cry again, and she quickly leaned on her grandma's shoulder.
Mrs. Tong sighed and patted her granddaughter's shoulder gently, "Don't blame your grandmother for being harsh to you all these years. Your father is a ruthless and selfish person, and the step-wife in Kyoto Mansion is even more sweet-faced and bitter-hearted. She regards you as a thorn in her side. It’s a thorn in my side. Fortunately, I brought you back from Kyoto, otherwise you would be having a hard time now. I always think that if you learn more and have the skills, it will be easier to survive in the future, but it’s hard for you.”
Tong Youyou quietly wiped away her tears, hugged her grandmother's arm and said coquettishly, "Grandma, what are you talking about? There is no one in the world who treats me better than my grandmother. How could I not know my grandmother's good intentions?"
Mrs. Tong smiled happily, "It's good that you know, grandma, I'm afraid I won't be able to accompany you any longer. I originally wanted to see you get married, but it's a pity that your health is not what you want."
"Grandma, you will live a long life!" Tong Youyou choked, not wanting her grandmother to continue talking.
Mrs. Tong shook her head, supported her granddaughter to face her, and said solemnly: "Yuyou, people are born, old, sick and die, and no one can stop it. Please listen carefully. Grandma has a few words to tell you."
Tong Youyou still wanted to speak, but Mrs. Tong pushed her and ordered: "Go and get my makeup box."
She quickly wiped away her tears, walked to the dressing table, and hugged the three-layered black lacquer and carved makeup box.
Mrs. Tong sat up and used her hands to
"After I die, based on your father's character, I'm afraid he won't be able to keep his filial piety at home, so he will definitely find a way to continue to be an official, but you will definitely keep it. That's fine. After returning to Kyoto to keep filial piety for a year, you will become familiar with living in Kyoto.
"I have already asked the clan leader. At that time, he will take several clan members to Kyoto to make decisions for you and handle your marriage. Your marriage was decided by your grandfather back then. The family was well-established and the descendants must have been good. Even if there are some mistakes, with the skills you have learned over the years, your life will not be too bad. If you take ten thousand steps back, no matter how bad you are, it will still be better than living under your stepmother.
"In addition, please remember that after returning to Kyoto, there is a bluestone alley in the east of Kyoto. At the end of the bluestone alley is a grocery store called Hu's Grocery Store. The shopkeeper and his wife were my dowry servants back then. The couple had no children and were very loyal. You have been staying in Kyoto for so many years and have some connections and skills. If you encounter difficulties in Kyoto, you can go to them for help. I will also send your dowry to them early and let them keep it. Here is the dowry list for you to have for reference in the future. "
Mrs. Tong said as she took out a booklet from the makeup box and handed it to her granddaughter. Without waiting for her granddaughter to speak, she took out a thick stack of banknotes. Each banknote was in small denominations of twenty taels or fifty taels.
"These silver notes are reserved for you, just in case. The denominations of the silver notes are small, so it is convenient for you to exchange them. Even if you arrive in Kyoto, you should have some money on hand to reward your servants, so that your life can be easier and faster."
Tong Youyou held the dowry list and banknotes in her hands, and could no longer hold back her tears. She threw herself into her grandmother's arms and choked with sobs: "Grandma, please don't leave. I can't bear to leave my grandmother."
Mrs. Tong couldn't help but shed tears, hugging her granddaughter with great reluctance, but she still had a hard heart and pushed her granddaughter away.
"Yuyou, listen to me, grandma knows that you are a filial child, but after returning to Kyoto, you must be ruthless and protect yourself. Grandma can no longer protect you, you can only rely on yourself.
"Also, we still have three thousand taels of silver in our house, which must be enough for me.I spent a lot of money on funeral arrangements. Jasmine and several other maids stayed with me for several years and worked very hard. If you can't take them back to Kyoto, just let them go. Their families are pretty good and they won't be left without a place for the rest of their lives. As for the maids around you, just make your own decision. Bring a few capable ones back to Kyoto so that someone can help you when something happens.
"I have promised my family's fields and the two hundred acres of paddy fields outside the city to the clan. You don't have to worry about it. No one will dare to say no to anyone coming from Kyoto or your father coming back."
After hearing this, Tong Youyou realized why her grandmother was so sure that her clan members would support her after her filial piety period was over. It turned out that her grandmother had handed over the fertile farmland outside the city in exchange.
Mrs. Tong said so many words in one breath, she felt a little tired. She pushed the makeup box to her granddaughter and said with a smile: "If you don't mind these things looking old, just keep them as a souvenir. The things in the warehouse will be left to people from Kyoto to clean up. If you don't keep some, your stepmother will make things even more difficult for you."
Tong Youyou was extremely sad, but her grandmother did not forget to make such arrangements for her when she knew her time was running out. "Grandma, don't worry, your granddaughter is not someone to be bullied and will live well."
"Grandma believes in you." Mrs. Tong smiled kindly and pointed at the tea cup on the table.
Tong Youyou hurried over to get a cup of warm tea. Unfortunately, when she brought it to the bedside, she saw that her grandmother had closed her eyes.
"Bang!" The tea cup fell to the ground and shattered.
"Grandma, wuwuwu...grandma! Wake up quickly, grandma, don't abandon me!" Tong Youyou knelt beside the bed, crying until she almost fainted.
The maids outside the house all rushed in when they heard the sound, and they all started crying when they saw it, "Old madam, oooooo... old madam!"
Butler Chen and the servants were not allowed to enter the house, so they could only kneel in the yard and cry hard.
It is said that one emperor and one courtier are the same, and the same is true in the Tong family compound. After Mrs. Tong passes away, someone from Kyoto will take over the compound in the future. By then, whether they will stay or go will be a problem. Everyone is saddened by their master's passing and worried about their own future.
Chapter 3 My son is missing (1)
Tong Youyou has been helping Mrs. Tong handle household affairs in the past few years. Although she is sad to leave, she cannot delay her grandmother's funeral.
She tried her best to hold back her grief, wiped away her tears, and began to tell everyone to get busy. The old lady's shroud and longevity materials have been prepared for a long time. All she needs to do now is to help the old lady clean it, put on the shroud, and wrap it in the longevity materials.
But there are also many trivial chores such as setting up a mourning shed and reporting funerals to relatives and friends of the tribe.
While we were so busy, the sky gradually became brighter.
The main entrance to the Tong family courtyard was wide open, and tall spiritual flags were erected beside the door. The leader of the Tong clan, along with a dozen clan members, hurried over, all looking sad.
The Tong family was originally just an ordinary small farming family. When Mr. Tong married Mrs. Tong, he brought a large dowry with him. Mrs. Tong spent a lot of money to support the children in her clan to study. Unfortunately, the Tong clan had limited aura, and only Tong Youyou's father was able to stand out. He was admitted to Jinshi and became a minor official in Beijing.
The rest of the brothers of the same generation have studied for several years and are good at writing and calculation. It is easier for them to make a living than children from ordinary families. In recent years, some tribesmen have worked as accountants in the city, some have opened trading shops, and some have worked as police officers in the yamen. Put together in one place, they can be counted as a force with a large number of people. As a result, the Tong family barely managed to get on the stage in Taizhou, and their lives were naturally good. The clan members were quite grateful, and they all rushed over when they heard that Mrs. Tong had passed away.
The clan leader is already sixty years old this year, with gray hair and beard. His four sons are in their prime, so he is very prestigious in the clan. Although he is a bit greedy, he is fairly fair.
What's more, Mrs. Tong previously gave away the land deed to two hundred acres of paddy fields. In the future, the crops produced in the fields will be enough for the children of the clan to continue studying and take exams, and evenThe cost of worshiping ancestors every year is enough to cope with any difficulties the clan may have.
Due to emotions and reasons, the clan paid great attention to Mrs. Tong’s funeral.
Butler Chen took the servants to set up a mourning shed in the yard, and Tong Youyou invited the clan leader and clan members to sit down in the main room to drink tea and discuss how to mourn.
It was not easy for a girl like Tong Youyou to come forward to discuss these matters, so she simply took out two thousand taels of money from the accounting room and gave them to the clan leader.
